title: Sparkly strawberry
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='berryGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff4d6d'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e6192e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c41024'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='leafGrad' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5ce65c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1fa31f'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <!-- sparkle top left -->
    <line x1='18' y1='18' x2='18' y2='10'/>
    <line x1='14' y1='14' x2='22' y2='14'/>
    <line x1='15' y1='11' x2='21' y2='17'/>
    <line x1='21' y1='11' x2='15' y2='17'/>
    <!-- sparkle top right -->
    <line x1='82' y1='22' x2='82' y2='14'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='18' x2='86' y2='18'/>
    <line x1='79' y1='15' x2='85' y2='21'/>
    <line x1='85' y1='15' x2='79' y2='21'/>
    <!-- sparkle mid left -->
    <line x1='12' y1='48' x2='12' y2='42'/>
    <line x1='9' y1='45' x2='15' y2='45'/>
    <!-- sparkle mid right -->
    <line x1='89' y1='52' x2='89' y2='46'/>
    <line x1='86' y1='49' x2='92' y2='49'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom left -->
    <line x1='22' y1='82' x2='22' y2='76'/>
    <line x1='19' y1='79' x2='25' y2='79'/>
    <!-- sparkle bottom right -->
    <line x1='80' y1='78' x2='80' y2='72'/>
    <line x1='77' y1='75' x2='83' y2='75'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small star sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff9c4'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='10' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='90' cy='35' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='62' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='15' cy='90' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='88' r='2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Strawberry body -->
  <path d='M50 32
           C68 32 80 48 78 62
           C76 78 62 88 50 90
           C38 88 24 78 22 62
           C20 48 32 32 50 32 Z'
        fill='url(#berryGrad)'/>

  <!-- Highlight on berry -->
  <path d='M36 44
           C40 40 48 38 52 39
           C48 42 40 46 36 50 Z'
        fill='#ff8099' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Seeds -->
  <g fill='#ffd966' stroke='#e6b800' stroke-width='0.8'>
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='46' rx='2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-10 40 46)'/>
    <ellipse cx='58' cy='44' rx='2' ry='3' transform='rotate(10 58 44)'/>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-15 34 58)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='2' ry='3'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='56' rx='2' ry='3' transform='rotate(15 66 56)'/>
    <ellipse cx='40' cy='68' rx='2' ry='3' transform='rotate(-8 40 68)'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='66' rx='2' ry='3' transform='rotate(8 60 66)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='2' ry='3'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Leaf collar -->
  <path d='M50 32
           C46 30 40 28 36 32
           C32 28 28 34 32 38
           C28 36 26 42 32 42
           C34 46 40 44 44 40
           L50 34
           L56 40
           C60 44 66 46 68 42
           C74 42 72 36 68 38
           C72 34 68 28 64 32
           C60 28 54 30 50 32 Z'
        fill='url(#leafGrad)'/>

  <!-- Leaf vein lines -->
  <g stroke='#2db82d' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='38' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='62' y2='38'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='34' y2='36'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='66' y2='36'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small stem top -->
  <rect x='47' y='26' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#2db82d'/>

  <!-- Leaf top highlight -->
  <path d='M42 32 C44 30 48 30 50 33 C47 32 44 32 42 32 Z' fill='#8ce88c' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
